text: {"lessons":["I should make buy and sell decisions from expected risk and return, not let my purchase price or the pain of realizing a loss dictate my choices.","Taking profits can feel satisfying, but I should avoid selling winners automatically; I need to weigh each position against my plan and the portfolio's diversification.","A few trades have not prevented my account from falling overall, so I should set clear position-size and review rules rather than react to short-term price moves."]}
